description: This file contains classes and methods related to the compilation of Smarty {function} tags within the Smarty templating engine. It defines the compilation process for Smarty function blocks, including handling start and end tags, managing cache and plugin dependencies, and generating PHP code for template functions.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Function
classes.description: Handles compilation of {function} tags in Smarty templates, preparing the PHP function definition and managing cache and plugin dependencies.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Functionclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of {/function} closing tags, finalizing the PHP function code for Smarty template functions.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {function} or {/function} tags into PHP code, manages template buffers, and handles cache and plugin code generation.

methods.name: removeNocache
methods.description: Removes nocache segments from compiled PHP code inside Smarty templates.
